title: Applying for a summer internship
situation: You would like to work in tourism after you finish school, and you have seen the advertisement below on a careers website. Write a formal e-mail to Ms Grant to apply for the internship.
situationHu: Turisztikai pályára készülsz, és egy budapesti szálloda nyári gyakornoki programjára jelentkezel; írj hivatalos e-mailt Ms Grantnek.
stimulus:
SUMMER INTERNSHIP PROGRAMME
The Danube Grand Hotel, Budapest, offers a six-week paid internship for secondary school students interested in tourism and hospitality.
Interns will work at the reception desk and help organise programmes for our international guests.
Good English and communication skills required.
To apply, write to our Human Resources Manager, Ms Julia Grant.

points.text: explain why you are interested in this internship and how it would help your future plans
describe the skills and experience that make you a suitable candidate
ask about the working hours and whether interns receive any training

usefulPhrases.en: I am writing to apply for the summer internship advertised on …
usefulPhrases.hu: A … oldalon meghirdetett nyári gyakornoki programra szeretnék jelentkezni.

usefulPhrases.en: I am particularly interested in a career in tourism.
This internship would give me valuable work experience.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ez a gyakornoki program értékes munkatapasztalatot adna.

usefulPhrases.en: I have good communication skills and I work well under pressure.
usefulPhrases.hu: Jó a kommunikációs készségem, és nyomás alatt is jól dolgozom.

usefulPhrases.en: I would be grateful if you could tell me …
usefulPhrases.hu: Hálás lennék, ha tájékoztatna arról, hogy …

checklistExtra: Kerültem az összevont alakokat és a túl közvetlen, baráti fordulatokat?

modelAnswer.text:
Dear Ms Grant,

I am writing to apply for the summer internship at the Danube Grand Hotel, which I saw advertised on a careers website. I am particularly interested in a career in tourism, and after finishing school I intend to study hospitality management. This internship would give me valuable work experience in an international environment.

I believe I would be a suitable candidate. I speak fluent English and some German, and I have good communication skills. Last summer I worked as a volunteer at the tourist information office in Eger, where I helped foreign visitors and organised guided walks.

I would be grateful if you could tell me what the working hours would be. I would also like to know whether interns receive any training.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,
Réka Horváth

Last summer I worked as a volunteer at the tourist information office in Eger, where I helped foreign visitors and organised guided walks.
I would be grateful if you could tell me what the working hours would be.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a levél mindhárom szempontot teljesíti – az érdeklődés oka és a jövőbeli terv (szállodaipari tanulmányok), a képességek és egy konkrét, a feladathoz illő tapasztalat, végül mindkét kérdés (munkaidő és képzés).

Hangnem: következetesen hivatalos – Dear Ms Grant / Yours sincerely (a címzett neve ismert), összevont alakok nélkül, udvarias közvetett kérdésekkel (I would be grateful if you could …, I would also like to know whether …).
Szövegalkotás: klasszikus pályázati levél-felépítés – cél, alkalmasság, kérdések, záró formula (I look forward to hearing from you.) –, minden bekezdésnek egy feladata van.
Szókincs: érdemes megtanulni: I am writing to apply for …, which I saw advertised on …, I am particularly interested in a career in …, valuable work experience.
